high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by NDTV, a news channel. The post features a photograph of a street scene in what appears to be a village in Bihar, India. The setting is a narrow street lined with buildings on both sides. The buildings have a mix of architectural styles, some with brick facades and others painted in various colors like green and white. In the foreground, several people are gathered around bicycles and motorbikes parked along the street. Some individuals are standing, while others appear to be walking or moving about.
